title: Add the signed-in journey browser tests

source.ref: Functional QA 2026-10-28: another audit was source and metadata only; no authenticated browser flow was exercised

verify.note: The journey spec exists with a read-only tier and a write tier that refuses production hosts, the default test:e2e run excludes it, and the dispatch-only workflow boots a local Supabase. Proves the harness is wired, not that every journey is green: the first dispatched run is the reading.

detail: test/e2e/journeys.spec.ts walks sign-in landing, the Create a Space Wizard through Your look and the review, Start with this kit from /themes, event and Circle forms, Crew and upgrade pages, Space console pages and CRM pages (@journey, read-only, safe on a preview with the e2e member). The @journey-write tier creates a Space from the Nocturne kit, an event, a Circle join and a Stripe test-mode Crew checkout, and runs only with PW_JOURNEY_WRITES=1 on a non-production host, via .github/workflows/e2e-journeys.yml over a throwaway local Supabase. Not run in CI yet: selectors for the event form and Crew button are written from source and need the first dispatch to confirm. Findings land in /mnt/project-files/audits/functional-qa-2026-10-28/journeys.md.
